messages.english: Enter nursery tray dimensions in centimetres or inches.
messages.translation: Nghenisa mimpimo ya tithireyi ta xirhapa xa swimilana hi tisentimitara (cm) kumbe ti-inch (in).

messages.english: Enter usable nursery surface in square metres or square feet.
messages.translation: Nghenisa ndhawu leyi tirhisekaka ya xirhapa xa swimilana hi timitara ta xikwere (m²) kumbe tifiti ta xikwere (ft²).

messages.english: Keep nursery entries until their save is confirmed.
messages.translation: Tshika leswi nghenisiweke swa xirhapa xa swimilana swi ri kona ku fikela loko ku hlayisiwa ka swona ku tiyisisiwa.
Hlawula tiyuniti ta xirhapa xa swimilana
Kunguhato wa vuhumelerisi → Xikunguhati xa xirhapa xa swimilana

messages.english: Choose your units, enter tray sizes and usable growing surface, then save. Unknown equipment values stay blank; zero stock stays zero.
messages.translation: Hlawula tiyuniti ta wena, nghenisa vukulu bya tithireyi ni ndhawu yo mirisa leyi tirhisekaka, kutani u hlayisa. Mimpimo ya switirhisiwa leyi nga tiviwiki yi tshama yi nga tsariwanga nchumu; nhlayo ya switirhisiwa ya zero yi tshama yi ri zero.
